newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate falls on late buying, liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate falls on late buying, liquidity.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 50 basis points at a session low of 17.75 percent on Monday due to late buying encouraged by market liquidity and a firm peso, fixed-income analysts said.
"The market was under a little pressure this morning on speculation and a softer peso," an analyst said.
"But liquidity improved when dollars flowed into Mexico and the market calmed down," he added.
The benchmark 48-hour peso closed 0.55 of a centavo firmer at 7.9150/7.9165 per dollar.
